newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates end up despite funds inflow.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates end up despite funds inflow.

text.p: Pakistan's inter-bank money market rates remained pegged at high levels on Sunday despite an inflow of about one billion rupees, dealers said.
They said the rates were likely to maintain the high levels on Monday as no major inflow was expected.
Trading remained dull with borrowers outnumbering lenders, a dealer at Standard Chartered Bank said.
The overnight funds were traded at 17 percent as the inflow could not match the amount by which the market was short, the dealer said.
He said about four billion rupees were expected to have been discounted with the State (central) Bank of Pakistan at the end of the day, he said.
